note: Selection error: the statement reports how often 21,041 RCTs reported sequence generation and allocation concealment, a reporting-prevalence finding about the trials that was produced with GPT-4o-mini rather than a measure of GPT-4o-mini's accuracy. No comparison against humans or ground truth is made at this step.

Relevant: an ablation of the Idea Novelty Checker (o3-mini evaluator, gpt-4o re-ranker) measuring accuracy at predicting 'not novel' against gold labels on 58 ideas, so it reports AI performance on novelty assessment. FLAG for human review: the statement says the re-ranker was removed, but per the page the 13.79% condition swapped facet-based RankGPT for general-relevance RankGPT; fully removing the LLM re-ranker gave 10.34%.

Relevant: an ablation of a SciBERT-based novelty prediction model (fusing reviewer knowledge and ChatGPT-generated method summaries) measuring accuracy against ICLR reviewer-derived novelty labels on a held-out test split. It reports how well an automated system performs a novelty-assessment task against ground truth.

Relevant: it reports how three AI platforms (Poe Assistant, ChatGPT, Google Bard) performed IRB ethics review of 10 case studies, judged by two authors against the FERCAP/SIDCER handbook and ICH GCP guidelines. FLAG for human review: the statement says the platforms responded 'correctly', but the page says they only produced on-topic responses to all 10 cases, with GCP sub-issues missed in 9 domains and Case 10 missed by all three, so the wording overstates the finding.
